answer_1.quote: An important medical application of natural language generation (NLG) is the construction of assistive systems that take X-ray images of a patient and generate a textual report describing clinical observations in the images.

answer_2.quote: To ensure consistency with prior work in "traditional" RRG, we report BLEU, BERTScore, ROUGE-L, and F1-RadGraph. Additionally, we introduce F1-SRR-BERT, a new metric leveraging our SRR-BERT model...

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human review of 464 reports, sampled from the MIMIC-CXR test set and the CheXpert Plus validation set, with evaluations performed by five board-certified radiologists (Appendix B).
answer_4.guideline: The reader study focused on validating both structured reports and fine-grained disease labels derived from the SRR-BERT model.
